recordedWith: ad-hoc live reads of https://api.pacifica.fi/api/v1 (/info, /trades, /funding_rate/history, /kline, /book), 2026-10-19 (public mainnet, read-only; no repo recorder ran). See `captured` and `note` for the exact requests; added in commit 816d6c2.
note: Recorded answers. info = GET /info. casing: kPEPE (venue spelling) vs KPEPE (upper-cased by the CLI) on /trades, /funding_rate/history limit=3, /kline 1h, /book. solUsdcBook = GET /book?symbol=SOL-USDC (spot, served by the perp endpoint). klineErrors: 2m / 6h interval and a 4001-bar 1m range (HTTP 400). fundingPages: limit=4000 (rows trimmed to oracle_price / funding_rate / created_at) then limit=1 with its next_cursor. klinePages: a 4001-bar 1m window read as [start, start+4000 bars-1] and the rest; page 1 trimmed to its first and last rows.
